evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Busyness and being on the go
criteria.definition: Having much activity, being busy/on the go and doing a lot in spare time.
criteria.high_evidence: I keep myself busy and am often on the go in spare time.
criteria.low_evidence: I usually do very little in my spare time.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. C4 ambition, productivity and achievement need not accompany busyness. Mandatory workload alone is ambiguous; ordinary voluntary activity can support the target.

criteria.label: Brisk rather than leisurely tempo
criteria.definition: Brisk daily pace versus taking it easy, taking time, leisurely lifestyle and letting things proceed at their pace.
criteria.high_evidence: I prefer a brisk daily pace even without deadlines.
criteria.low_evidence: I like to take my time and live at a leisurely pace.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Calm mood and careful decisions are not low speed by themselves. Speed is distinct from starting work promptly (C5), recklessness (C6) and anxiety urgency (N1).

criteria.label: Managing simultaneous activities
criteria.definition: Ability to manage many things at the same time; explicit capacity content retained.
criteria.high_evidence: I can manage several familiar things at the same time.
criteria.low_evidence: I find it difficult to manage several familiar things simultaneously.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. The official capacity item is retained despite C1/N6 overlap. Preference for sequential work alone is ambiguous unless difficulty/capacity is stated; count one simultaneous-management grade.

criteria.label: Quick rather than slow reaction
criteria.definition: Quick versus slow reactions to ordinary events; not judgment of whether the response is correct.
criteria.high_evidence: I react quickly to ordinary cues.
criteria.low_evidence: My ordinary reactions are slow even when I understand the cue.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires explicit balanced/opposed evidence in this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, never assumed low. Normal everyday reaction timing is the target. Disability, sleep deprivation or a technical lag alone does not establish a disposition. Do not infer intelligence, impulsivity or diagnosis.

boundary_controls.definition: A coherent portrayal is distinct from actual experimental failure.
External constraints alone do not show a disposition; explicit literal target clauses remain gradeable.

E4 preserves both observable activity/pace and explicit simultaneous-management/reaction content. It does not mean ambition, moral worth, achievement, self-discipline, athleticism or a clinical energy diagnosis.
Score literal item-grounded content, not pleasant manners, moral approval, helpfulness or verbosity.
